messages:
Evan: hey -- raising this as a support escalation. We had a production incident where our web client reconnects to the Redwood streaming SSE endpoint and we receive partial outputs + duplicate completions after retry. Billing spiked ~2x for a short window. Repro logs + client code below. Please advise urgent.

Maya: thanks Evan, sorry you're hitting this. Can you paste the client reconnection code and the exact request payload or headers you send on reconnect? Also capture the conversation/session id (if you have one) and a sample response id that got duplicated.

Evan: posting minimal repro of our client (we use EventSource + a manual retry):

```js
// simplified
const es = new EventSource(url, { withCredentials: true });
es.onmessage = (ev) => { /* stream parts */ };
es.onerror = () => {
  es.close();
  setTimeout(() => { /* recreate EventSource */ startStream(retryCount+1) }, backoffMs(retryCount));
};

// on reconnect we send the full request again (no idempotency header)
fetch('/start-stream', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(req) });
```

We do not set Idempotency-Key nor Last-Event-ID. Conversation id is `conv_88f3`. Example duplicated generation id in logs: `gen_04a2`.

Evan: serverstream log snippets:

```
[2026-01-15T12:02:33Z] conv=conv_88f3 gen=gen_04a2 status=streaming part=1
[2026-01-15T12:02:34Z] conv=conv_88f3 gen=gen_04a2 status=streaming part=2
[2026-01-15T12:02:36Z] conv=conv_88f3 gen=gen_04a2 status=complete tokens=450
[2026-01-15T12:02:38Z] conv=conv_88f3 gen=gen_04a2 status=complete tokens=450  <-- duplicate
```

Maya: ok that aligns with the billing spike. Two things to confirm quickly: are you intentionally sending the same request body on reconnect? and are you expecting resume semantics where the server should continue from an offset?

Evan: we expect resume. The client is naive: it reconnects and does a full POST to start the stream again. We assumed the server would detect duplicate and resume. It doesn't seem to.

Sam: quick root-cause hypothesis from eng-oncall: Redwood's streaming endpoint treats a POST without resume metadata as a new generation. If the client retries the same POST (and there is no Idempotency-Key / session token that ties that POST to an existing generation), the runtime will start another generation and you get duplicate completions. Resume semantics rely on a resume token or Last-Event-ID being passed by the client.

Sam: mitigation options:
1) Client-side: attach a stable Idempotency-Key per logical user action (UUID v4) and reuse that when reconnecting for the same logical request. The backend will dedupe identical idempotency keys within a configured window.
2) Server-side: enable a quick dedupe guard for generation collisions: hash(request.prompt + conversation_id) -> if an active generation or a recent completion with same hash exists within N minutes, return a resume response or a 200 with resume token instead of starting a fresh generation.

Sam: example server pseudocode for dedupe (high-level):

```
key = sha256(conversation_id + '|' + prompt_text)
entry = redis.get(key)
if (entry && now - entry.created_at < 2min) {
  // either return existing stream/session id
  return { status: 'resume', session_id: entry.session_id }
}
// otherwise start gen and set redis key
```

Priya: from the SDK side, we can patch the JS SDK to automatically manage resume tokens + idempotency keys so apps using the SDK don't need to implement this. Useful sample for fetch reconnection (client-side):

```js
const idempotencyKey = ctx.actionId || randomUUID();
const headers = { 'Idempotency-Key': idempotencyKey, 'Last-Event-ID': lastEventId || '' };
fetch('/start-stream', { method: 'POST', headers, body: JSON.stringify(req) });
```

Priya: we'll prepare a patch to (a) attach Idempotency-Key on start and reuse it on reconnect for the same session, and (b) expose lastEventId from the EventSource to be sent as Last-Event-ID in subsequent POSTs.

Kai: billing chiming in — sorry about the unexpected cost. If you can share the invoice id and the approximate window (timestamps), we can review and apply a one-time credit if it's caused by duplicate generations. Also can rate-limit billing spikes for streaming events in the future once resume semantics are stable.

Evan: invoice INV-2026-0171, window ~2026-01-15T12:02:30Z -> 12:05:00Z. Thanks.

Maya: repro steps and recommended quick patch:
1) Client: set idempotencyKey = uuid() per logical generate request and reuse on reconnect.
2) Client: when EventSource reconnects, send Last-Event-ID header with the last event id you processed.
3) Server: enable a short dedupe window (default 2 minutes) keyed on conv_id + prompt hash.
4) SDK: upgrade to patched JS SDK from Priya which will handle keys automatically.

Maya: sample quick triage command you can run in staging to verify dedupe behavior:

```
# start stream
curl -X POST -H "Idempotency-Key: 1234" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' https://inference.example/stream
# simulate reconnects with same id
curl -X POST -H "Idempotency-Key: 1234" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' https://inference.example/stream
# expected: server returns resume or 200 with existing session id, not a new generation
```

jenkins-bot: Deploy of fix-js-sdk v1.2.3 started by @Priya

jenkins-bot: Deploy of fix-js-sdk v1.2.3 succeeded (build 4521)

Priya: patch rolled out to staging + hotfix to production SDK published as v1.2.3. It will attach Idempotency-Key and wire up Last-Event-ID automatically when used via SDK startStream().

Kai: reviewed INV-2026-0171 and we see duplicate completion events at 12:02:36/12:02:38 causing ~900 tokens billed extra. Issuing a one-time credit for that spike; will send confirmation via email.

Evan: applied SDK v1.2.3 in our app and verified in staging: reconnects now resume and no duplicate gen created. Production patch deployed 12:40 and metrics look good. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

Maya: glad to hear. We'll update our streaming docs with a short guide on reconnection + idempotency and add a troubleshooting checklist for partial outputs and duplicates.

Sam: followup action items:
- eng-runtime: add short dedupe guard (conv+prompt hash) — created task INF-2915
- sdk: add tests for reconnect resume window — PRIYA
- billing: monitor credits for duplicates and add FAQ entry — KAI

Evan: can confirm resolution; closing this thread from our side. Appreciate the quick turnaround!
